candidates.label: Feed Loading Failures and Error Handling
candidates.description: Users report frequent failures in loading posts, encountering persistent error messages like 'posts aren’t loading right now', and being forced to repeatedly refresh or reopen the app. The lack of clear communication during these outages exacerbates frustration.
candidates.quote: i opened the app expecting to be able to browse posts normally, only to be greeted with a message stating, “posts aren’t loading right now. try again.”

candidates.label: App Performance Degradation (Freezing/Lags)
candidates.description: Significant performance issues are reported where basic interactions such as sharing, commenting, and liking cause the screen to freeze for multiple seconds, leading to a poor user experience.
candidates.quote: they freeze the screen for multiple seconds. it is very frustrating

candidates.label: Notification System Bugs
candidates.description: A long-standing bug causes tapping on a single notification to dismiss all others or force reload the home page incorrectly, preventing users from viewing missed notifications properly despite numerous updates.
candidates.quote: tapping to view one will dismiss the rest, forcing you to scroll through your notification tab to see what you missed.

candidates.label: Authentication and Login Issues
candidates.description: Users experience difficulties logging into their accounts, including being told to download the official app while already using it, and general refusal to accept valid credentials.
candidates.quote: the app keeps on refusing me to login my account. i have updated the app buh still the same thing.

candidates.label: False Positive Account Suspensions and Shadow Banning
candidates.description: Users report being suspended or shadow-banned without clear reasons, often attributed to automated systems misidentifying them as bots. Appeals are frequently denied instantly by AI, leaving users unable to use their accounts.
candidates.quote: my 10 year account was suspended for “inauthentic behavior” and thus far, all appeals have been instantly denied the moment i press send.

candidates.label: Feed Stability and Performance Issues
candidates.description: Users report significant technical instability including timeline locking, threads becoming unavailable, and general glitches that prevent normal usage of the feed.
candidates.quote: timeline locks up, threads are unavailable a lot

candidates.label: Multimedia Display and Loading Defects
candidates.description: Specific complaints regarding video playback issues (zoomed-in view requiring manual adjustment) and inability to scroll through pictures smoothly.
candidates.quote: any video you click on the app is slightly zoomed in

candidates.label: Arbitrary Account Suspension and Shadow Banning
candidates.description: High volume of reports regarding unexplained account suspensions, limited functionality without explanation, and shadow banning where posts/replies are hidden or detached from threads.
candidates.quote: my replies have been detached from threads and only my followers have seen my posts for a month now

candidates.label: Live Streaming Functionality Failures
candidates.description: Issues with the Live feature including random disconnections for both viewers and hosts, inability to see comments, and missing battery indicators.
candidates.quote: it randomly kicks me out and ends it too, and now i can’t see the comments my followers leave me

candidates.label: Navigation and Interaction Pain Points
candidates.description: Usability issues such as accidental navigation triggers when scrolling, difficulty accessing unread messages due to update prompts, and inability to write comments.
candidates.quote: when you scroll down, i always accidentally touch the left to open the home page

candidates.label: 信息流异常自动刷新与内容丢失
candidates.description: 应用打开或阅读过程中信息流会触发非预期的自动刷新机制，甚至出现双击刷新、点击通知强制重载主页等现象，导致用户正在浏览的推文突然消失且无法回溯查找。
candidates.quote: when you enter, when you start reading the tweet, the feed itself is updated and the tweet you read can no longer be found.

candidates.label: 应用卡顿与多账号切换死锁
candidates.description: 执行核心状态切换操作（如切换账号）时高频触发应用无响应或界面冻结，整体渲染与响应延迟显著增加，严重影响基础交互流畅度。
candidates.quote: switching between accounts causes the app to lock up maybe 50% of the time. no obvious reason why.

candidates.label: 多媒体加载失败与网络适配缺陷
candidates.description: 视频及图片等多媒体资源在特定网络环境下（如WiFi）无法加载，表现为持续转圈后抛出‘内容不可用’错误，附件下载功能亦存在间歇性失效问题。
candidates.quote: videos spin then turn to content is not available error. been happening for days

candidates.label: 核心交互控件失效与UI状态错位
candidates.description: 举报等关键功能模块按钮点击无响应，取消关注等交互动画与目标账户数据绑定错乱，部分新设备端发布动态功能被完全阻断。
candidates.quote: if you unsubscribe from people, the buttons work as crookedly as possible. you unsubscribed from one person, but at the same time the unsubscribe animation occurs with a completely different profile.

candidates.label: 账号封禁与恢复流程失效
candidates.description: 用户反馈账号在注册初期被永久锁定，且缺乏申诉或纠正违规的渠道，账户停用/重新激活流程存在逻辑死循环，严重影响核心账号功能体验。
candidates.quote: my account was locked permanently on my 2nd day for violating a rule but without any recourse to correct the violation.

candidates.label: 版本迭代导致的体验劣化
candidates.description: 多条评论指出每次应用更新后整体质量下降，新版本表现糟糕，且伴随对品牌更名（X）的不满，反映出持续的性能退化与交互体验滑坡。
candidates.quote: every update the app gets worse and this newest update is absolutely dog water

candidates.label: 内容审核机制争议与信任危机
candidates.description: 用户抱怨平台标签化与封禁机制缺乏透明度，仅因理性反驳即遭静音或处罚，配合“烟雾弹”式的产品表现，引发严重的社区信任流失。
candidates.quote: the app is a joke… labeling and banning just because you prove people wrong.

candidates.label: 核心功能萎缩与应用活力衰退
candidates.description: 部分基础功能（如自拍上传）出现异常或限制，结合用户普遍反映的应用状态低迷，表明核心功能生态正在快速萎缩，影响日常使用意愿。
candidates.quote: i’m not uploading a selfie. this app is dead.
